p: last days it shall come to: When Christ will come, and the temple will be destroyed.
teach us of his ways: He shows that there is no true Church, except where the people are taught by God's pure word.
rebuke strong nations afar off: By his corrections and threatenings he will bring the people into subjection who are in the utmost corners of the world.
pruninghooks: They will abstain from all evil doing, and exercise themselves in godliness and in well doing to others.
learn war any more: Read Isa 2:4
every one in the name of: He shows that the people of God ought to remain constant in their religion, even if all the world should give themselves to their superstition and idolatry.
a remnant: I will cause that Israel, who is now as one lame and halting, and so almost destroyed, to live again, and grow into a great people.
tower of the flock: Meaning Jerusalem, where the Lord's flock was gathered.
the first dominion: The flourishing state of the kingdom, as it was under David and Solomon, which thing was accomplished for the Church by the coming of Christ.
there no king in thee: In the meantime he shows that they would endure great troubles and temptations, when they saw themselves neither to have king nor counsel.

know not the thoughts of the: He shows that the faithful ought not to measure God's judgments by the braggings and threatenings of the wicked, but by these are admonished to lift up their hearts to God to call for deliverance.
O daughter of Zion: God gives his Church this victory, as often as he overcomes their enemies: but the accomplishment of this will be at the last coming of Christ.
